due_when.clears_when: A tradeify_1 round-trip-dry that reaches form_verified with no other alert exits 0 (then done), or the manager decides the exit-3 is acceptable for go-live (then killed with that reason).

origin.rerun: Dispatch a system-action issue: action: breakout-login-check / account: tradeify_1 / apply: round-trip-dry,limit ; read the last JSON lines for 'linked symbol could not be read' and the wrapper exit code.

what: tradeify_1's round-trip-dry ALWAYS exits 3 on a structural alert, so a real dry-walk failure is indistinguishable from a clean one. #15930 (run 37121646646, code 07d28188a) reached form_verified, stopped before submit, then raised 'linked symbol could not be read before the dry walk; not restored' because tradeify_1 has NO chart link (0 instrument_info_button / symbol_input, #15096/#15126). prop_executor.round_trip_failed() counts that alert (LINK_RESTORE_ALERTS) as a failure. Proposed fix (Tier-2, held): when the adapter reports the link unavailable for the account (as symbol_switch_dry already does via link_unavailable), record it as a note and skip the restore, keeping RESTORE FAILED fatal when a link WAS read.
